description.zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~)查询。
description.en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~) to query instance ID.

description.zh:
响应结果包含照片。

> 当前设置为ture或false均返回响应结果。
description.en:
Specifies whether the response contains photo URLs.

> The response is returned regardless of whether this parameter is set to true or false.

description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序。
description.en: The page number to return. Pages start from page 1.

description.zh: 检索范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the search range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 每页显示的条数。最大取值10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 10.

The search type. Valid values:
- **1** (default): face
- **0**: body.
The URL of the image to search.

description.zh: 检索范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the search range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
检索阈值。取值范围0~1。

> 建议设置检索阈值大于等于0.3，以保证与检测对象匹配。
description.en:
The search threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1.

> Set the search threshold to 0.3 or higher to ensure that the results match the detection object.
